title: Endorsement Deposits on Monthly Draft Plans — Installment Payment Plans Service Desk Reference
content:
**When it arises.** The named insured of an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** may ask to pay toward the additional premium an endorsement added to the term. The representative takes that endorsement deposit by a one-time card or bank payment the named insured authorizes. The deposit is held whole on the plan as a credit that the plan's draft notices carry as their credit schedule sets, and it is never applied to a draft notice already issued.

**Plans and terms it covers.** The endorsement deposit schedule covers such a plan only while its most recent installment invoice has at most one payment posted against it and its owner term backs at most one certificate. An owner term billed on any other plan, or on such a plan whose most recent installment invoice has two or more payments posted against it or whose owner term backs two or more certificates, is outside the schedule: no endorsement deposit is figured for it (the figure is 0.00), and a payment toward its additional premium is taken as every other one-time payment is, for the amount the customer states, and applied as every other payment on its plan is — on a Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term to past-due invoices oldest first (fees before premium), then to unpaid late and NSF fees, then to the current invoice, whatever it leaves being held on the plan as a credit that its draft notices carry as their credit schedule sets, and on any other plan in the plan's payment application order.

**When the deposit is fixed.** The endorsement deposit is fixed only after every installment whose invoice date has arrived is invoiced on the plan. Put the other way round: while an installment whose invoice date has come stands on the plan without its installment invoice, the deposit is not yet fixed.

**Authorization.** For an endorsement deposit, the named insured authorizes the payment personally by running it with the representative, choosing the payment method and confirming the amount the representative states.

## The payment function: `authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd`

**Capability.** Through `authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd` the named insured personally authorizes a one-time payment, taken today by a representative over the phone, toward the additional premium of an endorsement on the owner auto term the plan bills. On success a payment for the authorized amount is posted to the plan today through the representative phone channel, linked to that additional premium transaction and to no invoice; the plan's account balance falls by the amount; and a payment confirmation number is issued to the customer.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks `authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `billing_plan_id` | The reference number of the installment payment plan that receives the payment, read from the plan record returned by the plan lookup. |
| `source_auto_txn_id` | The reference number of the additional premium transaction of the owner auto term that the payment goes toward, read from the owner term's premium transaction lookup. |
| `payment_method` | How the customer pays, exactly one of: `debit_card` — the customer pays with a debit card they hold and state; `credit_card` — the customer pays with a credit card they hold and state; `bank_ach` — the customer pays from a checking or savings account they hold, by routing and account number; `personal_check` — a paper check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `money_order` — a money order the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cashiers_check` — a cashier's check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cash` — cash handed in at an agent office, never one taken over the phone. |
| `amount` | The amount the customer authorizes, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the payment confirmation number (PMT- followed by ten digits), the payment reference number, the amount (US dollars, two decimals), the method, the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the plan's account balance after the payment (US dollars, two decimals). The confirmation number indicates the payment was accepted and posted.
